suriname.title: Flag of the Republic of Suriname

colors.note: Upper and lower bands; represents the fertility of the land and forests.
Two narrow bands; represents peace and justice.
Wide central band; represents progress and love for the nation.
Five-pointed star at the centre; symbolises unity, a bright future, and sacrifice.

desc:
- Five horizontal bands of green, white, red (double width), white, and green, with a yellow five-pointed star at the centre
- Adopted on 25 November 1975 when Suriname gained independence from the Netherlands
- Designed by Jacques Herman Pinas after a national design contest
trivia:
- The five points of the yellow star represent the five major ethnic groups of Suriname: indigenous, Creole, Maroon, Indian, Javanese, and Chinese
- Green stands for fertile land, white for justice, red for progress, and yellow for a golden future
- Designed by Jacques Herman Pinas as the winning entry in the independence-era design competition
